description: Use this when you must decide fast whether an EVM token is worth a closer look: one verdict you can branch on (red_flags, caution, unknown or no_red_flag_found) with its reasons. Judges the same data as scan_token: the GoPlus contract checks (Powered by Go+ Security, https://gopluslabs.io), the deepest DexScreener pool and, for Robinhood Chain tokens, the traits the SWOGE AI colony measured on past tokens. Each flag carries its source, and each colony figure its number of observations. no_red_flag_found only means none of the checks fired; never a buy or sell signal, and unknown stays unknown.
